title: An install-local uninstall leaves the package's action handlers registered: a bare /actions call still refuses as ambiguous, naming the withdrawn package, until restart
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Found by a qa#3 routine round (owed:weekly) at objectstack main 0c2aeb96, beside the clauses of `api-backend.actions-namespace-address` (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8). Severity: low. Reproduced twice. No open issue matches; related but distinct: #33302 (install / enable routes do not announce metadata:reloaded — the install side, not the uninstall handler leak).

## Reproduction (stock showcase, own OS_HOME, admin session)

1. Build and `os package install` two scratch packages: `com.qa.addr-a` (object `qa_a_ticket` with an embedded script action `escalate`) and `com.qa.addr-b` (a standalone script action `escalate` with `objectName: qa_a_ticket`). Create one `qa_a_ticket` record RID.
2. `POST /api/v1/actions/qa_a_ticket/escalate/RID` → 409 naming both packages (correct: two holders, no package named).
3. `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/com.qa.addr-b` → 200, note "Cached manifest removed, the package withdrawn from the running kernel, …"; `GET /api/v1/packages/com.qa.addr-b` → 404.
4. Repeat step 2 → still 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` "Action handler 'qa_a_ticket:escalate' is ambiguous for a call that names no package: 2 owners register one ('app:com.qa.addr-a', 'app:com.qa.addr-b')…".

Expected: one holder is left, so 200 with `com.qa.addr-a`'s result — which is exactly what the same call answers after a restart.

## Mechanism (not proven)

The uninstall withdraws the registry entry and the package's metadata but not the handler registered under owner `app:com.qa.addr-b`; the bare-call ambiguity check (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`) reads the handler registry, so the withdrawn package still counts as a holder until the kernel is rebuilt.

QA-source: #33534 · api-backend.actions-namespace-address · observed beside the clauses
